# Supabase — Style Reference

> Graph paper on a lab bench, one green pilot light. Manrope headlines split between ink and graphite, a #fdfdfd sheet ruled with pale hairlines, and a single forest-green switch that starts every project.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Supabase speaks a two-tone engineering-notebook language. The canvas is an almost-white #fdfdfd, with #f9f9f9 for mockup wells and input fills and #ffffff for raised buttons. Text runs ink #030303, graphite #525252 and ash #a0a0a0. The chromatic budget is one hue, green, in two tones. #0e7e4e fills the primary action and colors the second line of the hero, and #3fcf8e is the logo bolt and the checked-state fill. Syntax colors stay inside code blocks. The typography thesis is that headlines split into two tonal registers at one size: an ink line answers a graphite line. Manrope sets them at 500 (46px) and 600 (34px) with zero tracking over Inter body at 450. Hierarchy therefore comes from value, not from size jumps. Shapes are soft: 8–9px buttons, 16–21px cards, and pills only for toggles. Elevation is a 1px #d8d8d8 hairline plus near-invisible inset ring stacks. The result reads as a lab notebook rather than a launch poster.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#fdfdfd` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background, nav bar fill, bento card fill. It sits 2 points off pure white, so #ffffff buttons read as raised without needing a shadow. |
| Fog Surface | `#f9f9f9` | `--color-fog-surface` | Dashboard mockup well, input fills, logo-band tint. It is the recessed tier, one tonal step below canvas, used where real UI is staged. |
| Quartz White | `#ffffff` | `--color-quartz-white` | Secondary buttons, code panel body, button text on green (10 uses). It is the only "lifted" tone, so it marks interactive or framed objects. |
| Ink | `#030303` | `--color-ink` | Headline lead lines, bolded key phrases in card copy, nav links, button labels. It is a near-black that keeps 21:1 contrast without the harshness of #000000. |
| Graphite Caption | `#525252` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Headline answer lines, hero paragraph, card body text (19 uses). It is the second register of the two-tone thesis and must hold 7.8:1 on canvas. |
| Ash Caption | `#a0a0a0` | `--color-ash-caption` | Footer links, illustration linework, placeholder text, metadata (31 uses, the most frequent text color). It is tertiary only. Do not set paragraphs in it. |
| Pebble Border | `#d8d8d8` | `--color-pebble-border` | Card outlines, input borders, nav bottom rule, logo-band rules (116 bordered elements). The single hairline does the work shadows do elsewhere. |
| Onyx Dot | `#000000` | `--color-onyx-dot` | Globe nodes in the Edge Functions illustration, framework icon discs, tiny state dots (16 background uses). It is decorative punctuation. Do not use it for text. |
| Forest Signal | `#0e7e4e` | `--color-forest-signal` | "Start your project" fills in hero and nav, hero line "Scale to millions". It is the one saturated action color. Do not tint whole sections with it. |
| Mint Pulse | `#3fcf8e` | `--color-mint-pulse` | Logo bolt, checked checkbox in the table-editor mockup, one focus border (3 fills, 1 border). It is a brand mark and state signal. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color, because white text on it fails contrast. |
| Moss Syntax | `#15593b` | `--color-moss-syntax` | Identifiers and env constants in code, "functions deploy" in the terminal chip (15 uses). It is a dark green that keeps code on-brand without shouting. |
| Iris Syntax | `#6b35dc` | `--color-iris-syntax` | `import`, `export`, `function`, `const` keywords in the React snippet (13 uses). It is confined to code. Do not use it for links or badges. |
| Ember Syntax | `#b45309` | `--color-ember-syntax` | String literals such as `'@supabase/supabase-js'` (3 uses). It is the warmest value on the page and is rationed to code strings only. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Manrope — display and section headlines, set quiet and untracked · `--font-manrope`
- **Substitute:** Manrope at 500/600 (free on Google Fonts, exact match), Plus Jakarta Sans at 500/600 (it draws marginally heavier, so do not go up a step), DM Sans at 500/600.
- **Weights:** 450, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 14px, 15px, 16px, 22px, 34px, 46px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 46px, 1.11 at 34px (1.2 in a 2-instance variant), 1.375 at 22px, 1.5 at 15–16px, 1.43 at 14px
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at every size, including 46px
- **Role:** Manrope carries every headline, but at 500 for the 46px display and 600 for 34px section heads it never pushes toward a bold or black. The step from display to heading is 46/34 = 1.35, which is a Perfect Fourth. The step from heading to card title is far steeper (34/16 = 2.1), so the system has only two real headline sizes. Untracked display type is anti-convention, since most developer-platform heroes pull in to −0.02em. Here, Manrope's open geometric apertures keep their natural spacing and read calm rather than compressed.

### Inter — UI, navigation and body copy at an in-between weight · `--font-inter`
- **Substitute:** Inter at 450 (variable axis, exact), Geist at 450, IBM Plex Sans at 400 (Plex draws heavier per weight, so 400 matches Inter 450's stroke).
- **Weights:** 450, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 22px
- **Line height:** 1.33 at 12px, 1.43 at 14px, 1.5 at 15–16px, 1.33 at 22px
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12–16px, -0.16px at 22px
- **Role:** Inter at 450 (143 uses) is the workhorse. It sits deliberately between Regular 400 and Medium 500, so grey body text keeps enough stroke to survive #525252 on #fdfdfd. Weight 500 is reserved for interactive labels: nav, buttons, and the 14px "Pricing / Docs / Blog" links. The only tracked value is -0.16px on the 22px "Use one or all." statement, a one-off tightening that marks it as a pull-quote rather than body.

### Source Code Pro — code, terminal chips and table-cell data · `--font-source-code-pro`
- **Substitute:** Source Code Pro at 500 (free, exact), JetBrains Mono at 400 (draws heavier, so drop a step), IBM Plex Mono at 400.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 13px
- **Line height:** 1.7
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 13px
- **Role:** One mono size at one weight, 81 uses, all of it inside code panels and mockup data cells. A 1.7 line height is unusually airy for code, where 1.5 is the convention. It gives the React snippet the rhythm of documentation rather than an editor. Weight 500 instead of 400 keeps 13px mono legible in #525252 and the syntax hues.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 450 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Source Code Pro | 500 | 13px | 1.7 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 450 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 450 | 15px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 450 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Manrope | 600 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter | 450 | 22px | 1.33 | -0.16px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Manrope | 600 | 34px | 1.11 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Manrope | 500 | 46px | 1.0 | 0px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Split section headlines into two lines at one size — Manrope 600 34px, one line #030303 and one #525252 — because value carries hierarchy here, not scale.
- Set body copy in Inter at 450, not 400 — the extra 50 units keep #525252 text dense enough on #fdfdfd to read as paragraphs rather than captions.
- Inside card copy, lift the single key phrase from #525252 to #030303 at the same 14px — this repeats the headline thesis at paragraph scale.
- Ration #0e7e4e to filled CTAs and the hero's second line — one hue at two placements keeps the start action the loudest object on a 101,162px-tall page.
- Outline every card with 1px #d8d8d8 and 21px radius (16px for compact cards) — the hairline replaces drop shadows across 116 bordered elements.
- Build padding and gaps from 8px multiples (8px appears 243 times) and separate sections by 96px — the rhythm stays comfortable without becoming spacious.
- Stage product UI as live markup inside a #f9f9f9 well with 16px radius — real components keep marketing and product typographically identical.

### Don't
- Don't enlarge or embolden the graphite half of a headline to 46px or 700 — a two-tone line at one size is the thesis, and a scale jump turns it into ordinary heading-plus-subhead.
- Don't use #3fcf8e as the CTA fill — white text on it measures under 2:1, so the primary action belongs to #0e7e4e and Mint Pulse stays a brand mark.
- Don't add `0 10px 15px -3px` shadows to cards — that stack is reserved for dropdown panels, and on tiles it breaks the hairline-only surface plane.
- Don't track Manrope 46px tighter than 0px — the conventional −0.02em squeeze makes the display read urgent, while the system's calm comes from untracked type.
- Don't let #6b35dc or #b45309 leave code blocks for links, badges or icons — syntax hues outside 13px Source Code Pro break the one-hue budget, and this is non-negotiable.
- Don't round primary buttons to 9999px — pills are reserved for toggles and static chips, and a round CTA erases the action-versus-state distinction.
- Don't set text in #000000 — ink is #030303, and pure black is never used for type because it belongs to 16 decorative dots and icon discs.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #fdfdfd (Paper Canvas)
- recessed surface: #f9f9f9 (Fog Surface)
- primary text: #030303 (Ink)
- secondary text: #525252 (Graphite Caption)
- tertiary text: #a0a0a0 (Ash Caption)
- hairline: #d8d8d8 (Pebble Border)
- brand mark: #3fcf8e (Mint Pulse)
- primary action: #0e7e4e (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts and bars stay neutral in #d8d8d8 and #a0a0a0, with exactly one highlighted series in #3fcf8e at a 30% opacity tint (solid only for a single current value), so the #0e7e4e CTA remains the most saturated object on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #0e7e4e, text #ffffff, Inter 14px weight 500, line height 20px, padding 8px 16px, height 38px, border-radius 9px, no CSS border, box-shadow `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.027), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.067)`. Place a secondary button 8px to its right with background #ffffff, text #030303, 1px solid #d8d8d8 border, the same 9px radius, 8px 16px padding and 38px height.

2. Build a hero section: a 1280px container on #fdfdfd with 160px top padding and 96px bottom padding, in two columns. The left column is a Manrope h1 at 46px weight 500, line height 1.0, letter-spacing 0px, with line one "Build in a weekend" in #030303 and line two "Scale to millions" in #0e7e4e, followed by 32px of space and the primary plus secondary button pair. The right column holds a 16px Inter weight-450 paragraph at line height 1.5 in #525252, max-width 576px, aligned to the headline top.

3. Build a feature bento card: background #fdfdfd, 1px solid #d8d8d8 border, border-radius 21px, padding 24px, no shadow. Header row: a 16px outline icon in #030303, 8px gap, title in Manrope 16px weight 600, #030303. Below at 12px: Inter 14px weight 450, line height 1.43, #525252, with one key phrase wrapped in a span colored #030303. Bottom: an outline illustration in #a0a0a0 that bleeds off the right edge with overflow hidden. Lay eight cards in a 4-column grid with a 16px gap, the first spanning two columns.

4. Build a navigation bar: height 65px, background #fdfdfd, 1px solid #d8d8d8 bottom border, position relative (not sticky), inner width 1280px. Left: logo, then 32px gap, then links "Product", "Developers", "Solutions" (with 12px chevrons), "Pricing", "Docs", "Blog", each Inter 14px weight 500 in #030303, padding 8px 10px, radius 8px, hover background #f9f9f9. Right, with 8px gaps: a GitHub count chip, a "Sign in" button and a "Start your project" button. All three are 26px tall with padding 4px 10px, Inter 12px weight 500 and radius 8px. The count chip is #ffffff with a 1px #d8d8d8 border, Sign in is #ffffff with #030303 text, and the CTA is #0e7e4e with #ffffff text.

The right-hand buttons are 26px tall with 4px 10px padding, Inter 12px at 500 and 8px radius. Dropdown panels take shadow lg. Hairline tile with live illustration. Background #fdfdfd, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 21px, padding 24px, no shadow. **Role:** Developer endorsement from X

A bordered quote slab. Background #fdfdfd, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 21px, padding 24px. **Role:** Switches Table, SQL and RLS views

The one fully round control. Height 38px, padding 8px 32px, radius 9999px, Inter 14px at 450. Inactive tabs have a #f9f9f9 fill, #525252 text and a 1px #d8d8d8 border. **Role:** Shows real product screens

A window, not a screenshot. Background #f9f9f9, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 16px, with three 6px window-chrome dots in #d8d8d8 at top left. It encloses a #ffffff panel of the actual table editor. **Role:** Shows the SDK in five lines

A documentation excerpt. Background #ffffff, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 16px. A top strip of six equal icon cells is divided by 1px #d8d8d8 rules. **Role:** Social proof at scale

A full-bleed ruled band. 1px #d8d8d8 rules run top and bottom, with vertical rules at the 1280px container edges. Twelve monochrome logos in #525252 sit in a 6-column, 2-row grid with 48px row spacing. Above the band, a 12px Inter 450 #525252 caption reads "Trusted by fast-growing companies worldwide". **Role:** Links a production-ready template

Compact bordered listing. Background #fdfdfd, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 16px, padding 16px. The tighter 16px radius against the 21px bento marks these as index entries rather than showcases.

### Two-Tone Section Heading — Split Register
**Role:** Opens every major section

The signature move. Manrope 34px at weight 600, line height 1.11, zero tracking, set as two lines at identical size. One line is #030303 and the other #525252, and either may lead: "Stay productive…" is ink first, "Use Supabase with / React" is graphite first. The heading is left-aligned in a 576px column with 32px below. Hierarchy is resolved by value rather than size, so no secondary heading size is ever needed.

**Role:** Hints at a one-line deploy

A shell prompt in a pill. Background #ffffff, 1px #d8d8d8 border, radius 9999px, padding 4px 10px, Inter 12px at 450. The `$ supabase` part is in #525252 and `functions deploy` in #15593b. It floats inside the Edge Functions bento card. It is the second permitted pill, allowed because it is a static label rather than a pressable action.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Split section headlines into two lines at one size — Manrope 600 34px, one line #030303 and one #525252 — because value carries hierarchy here, not scale.
- Set body copy in Inter at 450, not 400 — the extra 50 units keep #525252 text dense enough on #fdfdfd to read as paragraphs rather than captions.
- Inside card copy, lift the single key phrase from #525252 to #030303 at the same 14px — this repeats the headline thesis at paragraph scale.
- Ration #0e7e4e to filled CTAs and the hero's second line — one hue at two placements keeps the start action the loudest object on a 101,162px-tall page.
- Outline every card with 1px #d8d8d8 and 21px radius (16px for compact cards) — the hairline replaces drop shadows across 116 bordered elements.
- Build padding and gaps from 8px multiples (8px appears 243 times) and separate sections by 96px — the rhythm stays comfortable without becoming spacious.
- Stage product UI as live markup inside a #f9f9f9 well with 16px radius — real components keep marketing and product typographically identical.

### Don't
- Don't enlarge or embolden the graphite half of a headline to 46px or 700 — a two-tone line at one size is the thesis, and a scale jump turns it into ordinary heading-plus-subhead.
- Don't use #3fcf8e as the CTA fill — white text on it measures under 2:1, so the primary action belongs to #0e7e4e and Mint Pulse stays a brand mark.
- Don't add `0 10px 15px -3px` shadows to cards — that stack is reserved for dropdown panels, and on tiles it breaks the hairline-only surface plane.
- Don't track Manrope 46px tighter than 0px — the conventional −0.02em squeeze makes the display read urgent, while the system's calm comes from untracked type.
- Don't let #6b35dc or #b45309 leave code blocks for links, badges or icons — syntax hues outside 13px Source Code Pro break the one-hue budget, and this is non-negotiable.
- Don't round primary buttons to 9999px — pills are reserved for toggles and static chips, and a round CTA erases the action-versus-state distinction.
- Don't set text in #000000 — ink is #030303, and pure black is never used for type because it belongs to 16 decorative dots and icon discs.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#fdfdfd` | Page, nav, bento and testimonial cards: the default plane |
| 1 | Fog Surface | `#f9f9f9` | Recessed wells for mockups, inputs and inactive tabs |
| 2 | Quartz White | `#ffffff` | Raised objects: secondary buttons, code panel, active tab |
| 3 | Onyx Dot | `#000000` | Inverted micro-surfaces: framework icon discs, illustration nodes |

## Elevation

- **Primary button (Forest fill):** `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.027), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.067)`
- **Secondary and Sign-in buttons:** `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.027), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.067)`
- **Inner highlight on green and dark chips:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`
- **Avatar and image rings:** `0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)`
- **Nav dropdown panels:** `0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`

Cards carry no shadow at all. Depth comes from the 1px #d8d8d8 hairline and the three-step tonal ladder #f9f9f9 → #fdfdfd → #ffffff. Only buttons (at ≤0.067 alpha) and floating dropdowns cast anything.

## Imagery

There is no photography and no stock illustration. Imagery is either live product UI or monochrome technical linework. The bento cards hold line drawings in #a0a0a0 on #fdfdfd: an outlined elephant, a wireframe globe with #000000 nodes, a dotted vector cube, file-type icon tiles in 11px-radius cells. The drawings bleed off card edges and are never framed separately. Product views are rendered as live markup inside 16px-radius #f9f9f9 wells with a 1px #d8d8d8 border and no shadow. Icons are 16px single-weight outline glyphs in #030303. There are no gradients, glows or orbs. One-off fills such as #be93e4, #8e4ec6, #a9f1ca, #0070f3, #0c0f24 and #002533 appear inside template and partner art as decorative, not system tokens. The narrative is "this is the tool itself", shown at 1:1 rather than dramatized.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1280px container with 576px headline columns. Sections are separated by 96px, stretching to 128–160px around the logo band and the dashboard showcase. The hero is a left-aligned split. A two-line 46px headline and the green-plus-white button pair sit left, and a 16px graphite paragraph sits right. Directly below is an 8-tile bento: 4 columns, with Postgres spanning 2. Sections then alternate between ruled full-bleed bands (logos, footer) and contained blocks (tabs plus mockup, a 2-column heading-and-code split, 2-column templates, a masonry testimonial grid). The logo wall uses 6 columns. The nav is 65px, filled #fdfdfd, non-sticky, with logo and links left and the GitHub count, Sign in and CTA right. The footer is a 1097px multi-column link field in #a0a0a0. At 375px, drop display to 34px, stack every grid to 1 column, and use a 64px section gap. Density: comfortable.

## Two-Tone Hierarchy

The discipline is that a headline's emphasis lives in color value, not in size, weight or tracking. Every section opener is one Manrope 34px weight-600 block split into an #030303 line and a #525252 line. The same move recurs in the 22px "Use one or all." statement and inside 14px card copy. It breaks the moment a designer adds a 20px subhead below a 34px title, bolds the graphite line, or introduces a third gray such as #a0a0a0 into the pair. To extend it, add new section heads as two-line blocks at an existing scale step (34px or 46px). Flip which line leads to change emphasis rather than resizing, and keep the 7.8:1 contrast of #525252 as the floor for the quieter register.

## Rationed Green

The chromatic budget is one hue in two tones. #0e7e4e is the action and the hero's payoff line, and #3fcf8e is the logo bolt and checked state. Everything else on a 101,162px page is neutral, including twelve partner logos deliberately desaturated to #525252. The discipline breaks if green becomes a section background or icon color, if link text turns green, or if a second accent (a blue badge, a purple tag) is introduced for "variety". To extend it, express new states with tone and hairlines first. Use #3fcf8e only for positive state indicators at 16px or smaller, and allow one #0e7e4e fill per viewport. Keeping the start button the single saturated rectangle is non-negotiable.

## Quarantined Syntax

Code is the only place multiple hues may coexist. #6b35dc keywords, #15593b identifiers and #b45309 strings appear at 13px Source Code Pro weight 500 with line height 1.7, inside a #ffffff panel with 16px radius. The quarantine breaks when a designer borrows the purple for a "new" badge, uses the amber for warnings in marketing copy, or sets code at 400 weight so the hues thin out against #fdfdfd. To extend it, map any new token types (numbers, comments, JSX tags) onto the existing three hues plus #525252 and #a0a0a0. Keep the 1.7 line height and confine every syntax color to monospace text inside a bordered panel.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — The same light near-white canvas with 1px gray hairlines and shadowless cards. Vercel runs fully monochrome, whereas Supabase spends exactly one green.
- **Neon** — A direct Postgres-platform competitor that also builds identity on a green accent, but Neon leans into a dark canvas and glow, where Supabase stays on #fdfdfd with zero gradients.
- **PlanetScale** — Shares the developer-database habit of showing real product UI and code snippets as the primary imagery instead of illustration or photography.
- **Resend** — Shares the untracked, medium-weight display headline and the restraint of putting code panels at the center of the marketing narrative.
- **Firebase** — The closest category rival. It relies on bright illustration and orange-yellow gradients, the exact decorative register Supabase rejects for monochrome linework.
